0022600204.text: The Charlotte Hornets (3-7, 10th in the East, 2-4 at home) host the Cleveland Cavaliers (5-5, 7th in the East) in the Hornets' 11th game of the season, with Charlotte on a six-game losing streak and Cleveland on a one-game skid. Charlotte is missing Brandon Miller (groin soreness), Dennis Schroder (hamstring strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), and Kon Knueppel (hamstring strain), and Moussa Diabate is day-to-day with a quadriceps injury and a game-time decision, while Cleveland is without Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain) and Sam Merrill (elbow) and Jarrett Allen is day-to-day with a knee injury and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and Cleveland won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 118-113 win in Charlotte on February 20, 2026.
